title: Counseling
paragraphs: Trash’s pupils dilated as he looked at Fohl’s face. He pointed at Fohl with his right hand while clenching his left hand into a tight fist.
“What is the meaning of this!? A Hakuko is inside the castle! What is my wife doing!?”
Then, Trash pulled his fist back and charged at me. Since I shouldn’t hit him, I grabbed his face.
“Hakuko, die!”
“Whoa!”

Fohl instinctively crossed his arms to protect himself, stepping forward as if to shield the person behind him and bracing himself. Well, since I had Trash in my grasp, there was no need for him to worry.
“Guh! Damn you! Let go!”
Trash shifted his target to me, but I lightly tossed him aside by his head.
“Ugh… I’m not done yet! I’ll avenge Malty!”
As Trash prepared to lunge at me again, I quickly moved to stand behind Fohl’s little sister, who had been positioned behind him.
Trash’s expression froze instantly, and I could see the fight drain out of him.
“Um… Spear Hero-sama, brother, what should I do?”
“Why are you using Atla as a shield!?”
“I’m not. This way, he’ll calm down. If he tries anything, I’ll stop him.”
“Unbelievable—”
Before Fohl could shout, Trash slumped down and sat by the window, occasionally glancing our way.
“Well then, here’s my gift. Fohl, was it? You and your sister will take care of that old nuisance over there.”
“Huh? What kind of job is that!? You think I’m gonna do it!?”
“Um… you’re my brother… right?”
His sister called out to Fohl.
“What’s wrong, Atla? Is the air here bothering you? If so, we’ll leave right away.”
“No… I’m fine. But, brother, the one over there who feels somewhat like you… it seems our task is to take care of him. May I speak with him? I’m a little curious.”
“No way! He just tried to attack us!”
I’ve heard Fohl is extremely overprotective. Even in the previous loop, Ren and Itsuki mentioned it.
“Brother.”
“Ugh…”
“So, I’ll leave it to you. Just consider it counseling or something. If anything happens, tell the guards at the entrance, and I’ll come.”
“Yes.”
“Don’t just say yes, Atla!”
“Brother, please. That person…”
And so, I left Trash in the hands of the siblings and quickly departed.
—At the entrance of the tower. The Queen was standing there, quietly gazing up at the tower.
“They even tried to dodge responsibility for summoning the Four Holy Heroes without permission… blaming it on Trash, claiming that a Seven Star Hero took the lead, making it difficult to punish him.”
“Trash no longer holds any power, does he?”
“…It’s not that simple, unfortunately.”
According to the Queen, there are still factions trying to use Trash as a figurehead to push for demi-human exclusion. This situation has become quite complicated.
“I feel like everything would be solved if I just attacked the Three Hero Church’s headquarters.”
“Please be patient… I will likely have to ask you to do so soon enough.”
Hmm… the Queen seems to understand the situation to some extent.
“First, I believe there should be no problem if the heroes devote themselves to rebuilding the Seatto region.”
“Understood.”
“The Three Hero Church is currently lying low… When they finally reveal their true colors, we will crush them completely.”
And with that, I finished my conversation with the Queen. I’m looking forward to destroying the Three Hero Church.
“For that to happen… Trash needs to understand the situation and resolve to fight for the world. It will take some time.”
“Are you planning something?”

When I asked that, the Queen covered her mouth with her fan and nodded. She probably has her own strategy in mind. In the meantime, we’ll raise our levels while developing the land. Father and the others also need various materials to acquire different types of weapons.

Using the funds pooled from the gathered slaves and reconstruction support, I’ll continue purchasing more and more Filolials! To summarize the results, Father is still working with big sister’s big sister to take care of the slaves. Thanks to Father’s naturally kind and caring nature, the slaves are much more cheerful and are actively contributing to the village’s reconstruction, even more so than in the previous timeline. Little by little, the village is being restored to the state it was in the first world. Ren and Itsuki also seem to have no complaints as they take the slaves to level up. Of course, the heroes sometimes go hunting together to compare notes. Even if the heroes’ levels don’t increase, the levels of the slaves and Filolials will. As we were doing that, the wave in Melromarc was suddenly upon us. Since waves also occur in other regions, we occasionally participated in waves in other countries as well. Itsuki has already started using firearms. He’s progressing faster than last time.
“This time, I’ll get my revenge on the wave!”
Keel was burning with determination as he prepared. Only a few minutes remained before the wave in Melromarc.
“I’m scared…”
“It’s okay, Raphtalia-chan. You don’t have to join the battle.”
“But… Rifana-chan…”
Big sister declined to participate this time. In her place, her friend volunteered.
“Kou will do his best!”
“Let’s do our best!”
“Yeah!”
Big sister’s friend mounted Kou’s back, showing her resolve to fight.
“Raphtalia-chan, you stay in a safe place. Sadeena will be in the village to protect it, so this time the village won’t be destroyed by the wave!”
“B-but…”
Big sister’s friend got off Kou and gently placed her hand on Raphtalia’s cheek to reassure her.
“That’s right. If we can stop the wave this time without any major damage… I think that anxiety will disappear.”
“Yes. It seems that a lot of damage was caused last time.”
“The scars it left behind are severe. I might have overlooked it if I had kept thinking this was just a game…”
Oh, Ren and Itsuki also seem to have strengthened their resolve after witnessing the scars left by the previous wave. Rebuilding the village early has some advantages like this.
“That’s why, Raphtalia-chan, stay in the village. We’ll… hold back the wave.”
“O-okay. I understand.”
